## Comparison of the Two Traces

Both traces follow essentially the same approach: a linear step-by-step simulation of the state machine over all 17 events. They diverge little in substance—both correctly identify the same 5 rejections (events 2, 3, 7, 16, 17) and arrive at the same final configuration (FAULT, A=false, T=false, n=13).

The main divergence is in verification style. Trace 1 includes a full "Re-verification" section that re-executes the entire simulation, then adds analysis about state reachability (READY and PAUSED are unreachable). Trace 2 is more granular, re-verifying individual registers (A, T, n) and specific rejected events one at a time. Both traces exhibit extensive rework—re-checking steps already completed—which constitutes LOOP behavior. Neither trace explores alternative branches (no CYCLEs), and neither introduces ungrounded content (no MUSEs).

---

## Annotations for Trace 1

⟦LOOP⟧ trace=1 conf=clear start="Let me double check the 'guards' logic" end="Rejections: 2, 3, 7, 16, 17." basis=Re-executes the full simulation of all 17 events already completed in the main trace, producing the same results.⟧
⟦LOOP⟧ trace=1 conf=clear start="Let's double check if I missed any 'READY' or 'ACTIVE' transitions." end="So READY is indeed a sink/source that is never entered." basis=Re-checks state transitions and allowed-state lists already verified in the main trace and re-verification.⟧
⟦LOOP⟧ trace=1 conf=clear start="Is there any dependency I missed?" end="Step 16, 17: TICKET. State FAULT. Rejected." basis=Re-checks guards for steps 3, 6, 7, 12, 14, 16, 17 that were already verified multiple times.⟧
⟦LOOP⟧ trace=1 conf=clear start="One last check on the 'first rejected event'." end="State after Step 1: DONE, T=true." basis=Re-checks step 3's guard evaluation, which was already verified in the main trace, re-verification, and dependency check.⟧
⟦LOOP⟧ trace=1 conf=probable start="State INIT (from Step 6)." end="Fault not in list." basis=Re-checks steps 7, 16, and 17 rejections that were already verified at least three times earlier in the trace.⟧

## Annotations for Trace 2

⟦LOOP⟧ trace=2 conf=clear start="Let me re-verify the rejection of event 3." end="So Event 3 is Rejected." basis=Re-verifies event 3's guard failure already analyzed in the main simulation.⟧
⟦LOOP⟧ trace=2 conf=clear start="Wait, did I miss any?" end="Total rejected: 2, 3, 7, 16, 17." basis=Re-enumerates all 17 events as accepted or rejected, duplicating the classification already completed in the main trace.⟧
⟦LOOP⟧ trace=2 conf=clear start="Let me double check the state transitions again very carefully." end="**Status:** S=FAULT, A=F, T=F, n=13." basis=Re-executes the full state-transition simulation for all 17 events, reproducing results already obtained.⟧
⟦LOOP⟧ trace=2 conf=clear start="Let me double check the CLOSE rule again." end="Accepted. n becomes 11. S becomes INIT. Correct." basis=Re-checks CLOSE guard evaluations for events 3, 6, 12, 14 already verified in the main trace and re-simulation.⟧
⟦LOOP⟧ trace=2 conf=clear start="Wait, did I set T correctly?" end="Final T is false." basis=Re-traces T register values for all 17 events, duplicating tracking already done throughout the main simulation.⟧
⟦LOOP⟧ trace=2 conf=clear start="Event 1 OPEN -> A=false." end="Final A is false." basis=Re-traces A register values for all 17 events, duplicating tracking already done throughout the main simulation.⟧
⟦LOOP⟧ trace=2 conf=clear start="1: OPEN -> 0." end="Final n is 13." basis=Re-traces n register values for all 17 events, duplicating tracking already done throughout the main simulation.⟧
⟦LOOP⟧ trace=2 conf=probable start="2: TICKET (State DONE not in {INIT, ACTIVE, PAUSED})." end="Total 5 rejected events." basis=Re-enumerates rejection reasons for events 2, 3, 7, 16, 17 already listed multiple times.⟧
